title: Security tips for QR transfers
summary: This document provides security tips for QR transfers: use the confirmation screen to verify recipient and amount, share QR codes only with the intended payer, hide/close the QR after completion, and avoid risky screenshots. It also advises safe scanning (trusted sources, check for tampering stickers, use the in-app scanner, keep the app updated) and what to do if something looks off (cancel, verify details with the other party, regenerate a new QR and compare).
